content:
mohit: FYI incoming engagement from RedHorse next Tue. Need to finalize assessor access (RBAC), KMS decrypt pattern, and evidence packaging. Goal: minimal blast radius, quick retest path. tagging @dina @carla
dina: Thanks. Scope? staging only or include sandbox connectors? any database read access requested?
mohit: staging + sandbox only. No db read. They asked for short-lived decrypts to validate artifact integrity. No permanent keys.
carla: ephemerals only. We should require an evidence_manifest.json with sha256s + signed metadata. Presign S3 objects with 24h TTL and place into sec-audit-bucket/pentest/redhorse/YYYYMMDD/. Also enforce requester IP CIDR on presigned URLs where possible.
ashley: Also we need a SIEM snapshot during the test and a retention bump for the export window. Propose 14 days hot retention, then archive. Any objections?
samir: 14 days is fine. If assessors need longer we can create a handoff archive tarball post-test. I'll do a quick cost calc and post here.
mohit: Proposed ephemeral role policy: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/assessor/redhorse-ephemeral with permissions: s3:GetObject on sec-audit-bucket/pentest/redhorse/*, kms:Decrypt on alias/pentest-evidence-key, logs:FilterLogEvents on /aws/redwood/audit. Condition: SourceIp + TimeWindow + MFA present. Rotate creds hourly and max session 1h. Thoughts?
dina: Add deny for kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:CreateGrant. Only allow Decrypt. Also ensure CloudTrail records assume-role events to a central audit account.
carla: We'll require evidence_manifest.json format: an array of objects {"path":string, "sha256":string, "size":int, "signed_by":string}. Include manifest.sig (detached sig by our internal signer). Reject uploads w/o manifest.
ashley: Runbook reqs: quick ops steps + pause/resume flow if noise floods production. Minimal commands: assume-role, download, verify manifest, run sha256 checks. Add: how to revoke assessor access mid-window.
mohit: i'll flesh out runbook and a terraform var feature-flag to flip pause/play. Also will add a scheduled audit-export command we can run pre/post window: audit-export --start 2026-05-05T09:00Z --end 2026-05-05T17:00Z --dest s3://sec-audit-bucket/pentest/redhorse-exports/
oncall-bot: Reminder: RedHorse pen-test scheduled 2026-05-05 09:00-17:00 UTC. Paging policy: security-oncall.
carla: Retest candidates: 2026-05-12 09:00-11:00 UTC or 2026-05-19 13:00-15:00 UTC. I'll block both tentatively until they confirm. We'll snapshot staging 30m before start as a canary.
samir: Cost note: 14-day hot retention ~ $120 for the expected volume; archiving exports adds ~$20. Flagging finance if we go beyond 30d.
dina: I'll draft the intake email + attach a manifest template and the minimal evidence requirements. Also will add assessor rules: access window, no lateral movement, least privilege.
ashley: Example snippets for runbook:
```bash
# assume ephemeral role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/assessor/redhorse-ephemeral --role-session-name redhorse-2026 --duration-seconds 3600
# download artifact
curl "<presigned-url>" -o artifact.tar.gz
# verify manifest
jq -r '.[] | "\(.path)  \(.sha256)"' evidence_manifest.json | sha256sum -c -
# revoke session (if needed)
aws iam revoke-session --session-id <id>  # (pseudo)
```
mohit: Please keep commands minimal, link to official runbook page after PR. Action items: @dina prepare intake + manifest template, @carla block retest slots & snapshot, @ashley add runbook commands + retention bump, @samir post cost note + finance ping. I'll open the ephemeral-role PR and include checklist.
carla: checklist for PR: [ephemeral role policy], [presigned S3 prefix], [manifest validation], [audit-export job], [runbook link]. Makes handoff fast. :white_check_mark:
ashley: one more ops detail: ensure we log all assume-role STS events to the security central account and tag exports with engagement-id for traceability.
dina: ack. I'll include tagging requirements in the intake template.
mohit: thanks team. i'll post the PR link here when created. If anyone needs to escalate during the window, page security-oncall.
carla: +1. Also let's redact any PII from artifacts before packaging; add that to the intake checklist.
samir: posted the cost estimate in the intake doc. tagging finance now.
mohit: closing loop 1: will share final runbook + PR early next week.
